trap.label: present perfect × passado
trap.wrong: Last year I have been afraid of speaking.
trap.right: Last year I was afraid of speaking.
trap.why: Em português “Ano passado eu tive medo” ou “já tive” se misturam. Em inglês, marcador de tempo passado fechado (last year) exige Past Simple.

mcq.q: I ___ to ask for help now.

fix.wrong: I have visited Rome last summer.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no Past Simple: “I have been afraid of tests.” (last year)
rewrite.answer: Last year I was afraid of tests.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com have: “I learn to speak.” (até agora)
Reescreva no passado: “She mentions a new rule.”
